title: Yeska: The Populist and Ethics
description: You are Yeska, the Chairman of the Bhumi Krida Party (PBK). Known as an idealist and anti-corruption figure, your political ambition now tests your sweet promises.

chapter1.title: The Conservation Land Dilemma
chapter1.description: For the sake of food security promises, you need new agricultural land. Conservation land is available, but opening it means betraying environmental activists.
chapter1.dilemma: Open conservation land or find an expensive alternative?

A.feedback: Very expensive, but activists praise you as a green visionary.

B.feedback: Farmers are happy to get land, but activists start labeling you as an environmental destroyer.

chapter2_A.title: Job Trading Scandal
chapter2_A.description: Your Vice Chairman is caught red-handed trading positions for money. The money flowed into the party coffers. Your integrity is at stake.
chapter2_A.dilemma: Protect your friend or clean up the party?

A.feedback: The party is turbulent, but the public sees you as a cleansing hero.

B.feedback: The problem is solved quietly, but a skeleton is kept in the closet.

chapter2_B.title: Job Trading Scandal (Pressured Position)
chapter2_B.description: Already protested over the environment, now the Vice Chairman is involved in a job bribery case. The party is on the brink.
chapter2_B.dilemma: Protect your friend or clean up the party?

A.feedback: A brave but costly step. The old faction starts to hate you.

B.feedback: You choose false stability. The public begins to suspect your play-acting.

chapter3_A.title: Grey Campaign Funds
chapter3_A.description: The election is near, coffers are empty. There is an offer of regional government grant funds laundered through a fictitious foundation for the campaign.
chapter3_A.dilemma: Take grey funds or run a poor campaign?

A.feedback: A luxurious campaign begins. But you know this is stolen public money.

B.feedback: A thrifty campaign. Few banners, but abundant moral support.

chapter3_B.title: Grey Campaign Funds (Closed Case)
chapter3_B.description: The party needs quick cash to cover up old scandals and win the election. There is an offer of regional government grant funds through a backdoor channel.
chapter3_B.dilemma: Take grey funds or run a poor campaign?

A.feedback: Money pours in. Your hypocrisy thickens.

B.feedback: You try to be honest at the last minute. The risk of losing the election looms.

chapter4_A.title: ID Card Project Kickback
chapter4_A.description: The ID Card consortium offers a giant kickback for the project to run smoothly in Parliament. This is a ticket to eternal personal wealth.
chapter4_A.dilemma: Accept bribe or report to the KPK (Anti-Corruption Agency)?

A.feedback: You become a national hero! But your political enemies are now seeking revenge.

B.feedback: Fat bank account. The sweet promises of anti-corruption are just memories.

chapter4_B.title: ID Card Project Kickback (Clean Position)
chapter4_B.description: Even with limited campaign funds, temptation comes from the ID Card project. A large kickback awaits if you turn a blind eye.
chapter4_B.dilemma: Accept bribe or report to the KPK?

A.feedback: Your integrity is proven to be not just talk.

B.feedback: You finally give in to temptation. Money changes everything.

chapter5_A.title: Cadre Regeneration: Loyalty vs. Competence
chapter5_A.description: The party needs regeneration. The old faction wants blind loyalty, the young faction wants technical competence.

A.feedback: A safe compromise. The party is stable but slow to move.

B.feedback: You remove the old guard. The party is now entirely yours, but enemies multiply.

chapter5_B.title: Cadre Regeneration: Securing Position
chapter5_B.description: With corruption money in hand, you need loyal cadres to protect secrets, not smart ones.

A.feedback: Trying to look democratic while covering your tracks.

B.feedback: You discard all critical people. The party becomes a nest of flatterers.

chapter6_A.title: The Temptation of Radical Populism
chapter6_A.description: Popularity is stagnant. Political consultants suggest radical/extremist rhetoric to ignite mass emotion and win quickly.

A.feedback: The masses cheer, the nation is divided. You are playing with the fire of national unity.

B.feedback: You are a true statesman. Less popular, but maintaining public sanity.

chapter6_B.title: The Temptation of Radical Populism (Authoritarian)
chapter6_B.description: You have cleaned up the internal party. Now the temptation to use a radical narrative for absolute power is stronger.

A.feedback: Power is in your hands, but the country is on the brink of civil conflict.

B.feedback: You choose the difficult path for long-term stability.

chapter7_A.title: Meat Import Bribery
chapter7_A.description: Need Presidential campaign funds. Meat importers offer a jumbo bribe provided the import quota is opened through the Ministry of Agriculture owned by your party.
chapter7_A.dilemma: Accept import bribe or strictly supervise?

A.feedback: You lose a large fund, but meat prices are stable and the people are happy.

B.description: Force Minister to Issue Permit (Accept Bribe)
B.feedback: Party coffers are full. Local farmers suffer as imported meat floods the market.

chapter7_B.title: Meat Import Bribery (Moral Position)
chapter7_B.description: Even though you maintain ethics, the temptation of Presidential campaign money is very strong. Meat importers put a blank check in front of your eyes.
chapter7_B.dilemma: Accept import bribe or strictly supervise?

A.feedback: Your integrity is consistent. You are a rare politician.

B.description: Force Minister to Issue Permit (Accept Bribe)
B.feedback: Your moral defense collapses for the sake of the Presidential seat.

chapter8_A.title: Ideological Shift: Rajendraism
chapter8_A.description: To win the Presidential election, you need the center vote. The party's pragmatic 'Rajendraism' ideology needs to be implemented, but the old cadres refuse.
chapter8_A.dilemma: Change ideology by force or dialogue?

A.feedback: The change goes smoothly without resentment. The party is solid.

B.feedback: You force your will. Many senior cadres quit and form an opposition.

chapter8_B.title: Ideological Shift: Rajendraism (For Power)
chapter8_B.description: With illicit meat import funds, you feel you can buy loyalty. You want to change the party's ideology as you wish.
chapter8_B.dilemma: Change ideology by force or dialogue?

A.feedback: You pretend to be democratic to quell the turmoil.

B.feedback: The party is now your personal property. Internal democracy is dead.

chapter9_A.title: Authoritarian Power
chapter9_A.description: Winning the Presidential election makes you feel above the law. You want to issue controversial policies without Parliamentary approval.
chapter9_A.dilemma: Use presidential decree or legal channel?

A.feedback: Effective but dangerous. You start acting like a dictator.

B.feedback: Slow but sure. You respect the democratic system.

chapter9_B.title: Authoritarian Power (Dirty Trail)
chapter9_B.description: Many past sins must be covered up. Absolute power through a Presidential Decree is the best way to protect yourself.
chapter9_B.dilemma: Use presidential decree or legal channel?

A.feedback: The law is now under your heel.

B.feedback: You try to return to the right path, even though enemies await around the corner.

chapter10_A.title: Constitutional Amendment
chapter10_A.description: The peak of power. You are tempted to change the Constitution to serve for life or extend the term of office.
chapter10_A.dilemma: Become President for life or step down?

A.feedback: Congratulations, you have killed the democracy that raised you. A people's revolution awaits.

B.feedback: You step down honorably. History records you as the savior of democracy in the final hour.

chapter10_B.title: Constitutional Amendment (Democratic Path)
chapter10_B.description: The term of office is coming to an end. The temptation to extend power is immense, but the democratic legacy is also important.

A.feedback: Greed destroys everything. You are remembered as a reform traitor.

B.feedback: You leave the palace with your head held high. A true Hero of the Republic.
